manaNeeded: {7}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Time Walk and exiling the original Time Walk with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Time Walk copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Walk and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Time Walk's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Walk and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Time Walk's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
